m: dhurīṇa mfn. fit to be harnessed, L.
charged with, bearing (lit. and fig.), W.
dhurīṇa m. a beast of burden, L.
leader, chief, Pañc.; Hit. (cf. uttara-, eka-, dakṣiṇa-, sarva-).
a: dhurīṇa, dhurīya a. [dhuraṃ vahati, arhati vā, dhur kha cha bā] 1 Able to bear or carry a burden. 2 Fit to be harnessed. 3 Charged with important duties. — ṇaḥ, -yaḥ 1 A beast of burden. 2 A man of business, or one charged with important duties. 3 A chief, head, leader.
